openings.role: Research Internship at the Reserve Bank of India (DSIM – Department of Statistics and Information Management)
openings.exp: DSIM: PG Statistics/Econometrics/Economics or B.E./B.Tech (Computer) or degree in Data Science / B.Tech / B.Sc CS; open to domestic and foreign students; work experience not required
openings.jd: Interns assist RBI researchers on policy and journal research projects, compiling data and applying statistical/econometric tools; DSIM covers data warehouse, surveys, macro forecasting. Desirable: econometrics, Python/R/Stata, ML, Tableau/Power BI.
openings.verified: Official RBI opportunities page 200 (Vacancies > Research Internship); scheme states 1 Jan batch applications accepted July–November of previous year
openings.note: Standing scheme, not a dated notice. Apply by email to the department with CV, 2 references, SOP and the RBI form. Wording ('individuals who have been in college relatively recently') implies a held degree; check that a final-year B.Tech can join Jan 2027 with college permission. The deadline is inferred as end of November. Max 20 interns/yr.
